lines.zh: 我没有走过，我是被摆在这个角上的。
lines.en: I never walked; I was arranged in this corner.

lines.zh: 灯一亮，我就不会再动了。
lines.en: Once the lamp is on, I do not move again.
My hook points down the aisle.
I lean crooked against the post.
My eyepatch covers half my face.

lines.zh: 地上的灰被扫开，我才露出来。
lines.en: They swept the dust away, and there I was.

lines.zh: 我的脚一整天钉在原地。
lines.en: My feet stay rooted all day.
I was pushed into this spot.
The light comes at me from the side.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上挂着几片布。
lines.en: A few strips of cloth hang off my casing.
My head faces the entrance.

lines.zh: 有人的时候，我也这样站着。
lines.en: When people are here, I stand just like this.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的布吹动了。
lines.en: The draft stirs the cloth on me.

lines.zh: 我从台边被挪到了正中间。
lines.en: I was shifted from the stage edge to the middle.
This is my display position.
I stand with the hook hanging.
There is no light in that eye socket.

lines.zh: 一只眼睛看得见，另一只遮着。
lines.en: One eye sees; the other is covered.

lines.zh: 我的嘴角还是那副样子。
lines.en: My mouth sits in that same line.
Dust covers my shoulder.
My mouth stays half open.
No children come to play here anymore.
My joints are badly seized.
Footsteps are somewhere far off.
The lamp buzzes above me.

lines.zh: 我背上的布撕了一长条。
lines.en: A long strip of cloth is torn from my back.

lines.zh: 我从开门到现在没动过。
lines.en: I have not moved since the doors opened.
I do nothing in the daytime.

lines.zh: 我等着有人从这条走道过。
lines.en: I wait for someone to come up this aisle.
My shadow lies flat on the carpet.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，连眼都不眨。
lines.en: I do not stir, not even a blink.

lines.zh: 我用那只露在外面的眼睛看你。
lines.en: I watch you with the one eye left bare.

lines.zh: 你从走道上过来，看见了。
lines.en: You come up the aisle and see.

lines.zh: 我的钩子朝着你的方向。
lines.en: My hook points your way.
You stand before me, and I have not moved.
My face looks grey under the lamp.
My eyepatch sits a little crooked.
You might think I am broken.
Look at these strips on me.
I am still here in this corner.

lines.zh: 你看着我的时候，我什么也不说。
lines.en: While you look, I say nothing.

lines.zh: 我的钩子垂在你面前，没动。
lines.en: My hook hangs before you, unmoving.
You look at me, and I seem to look back.
I rock once and steady.
I made no sound at all.
A strip of cloth falls.
I took that one standing.
My head tilts further.
I cannot even dodge.
The post rattles where I hit it.
My position has not changed.
Another layer of dust settles.
You hold it up, and I cannot lift a hand.
Set it on the counter.
That will not keep me.
By daylight I chase no one.
My hook cannot reach it.
That is my only hand.
I have no interest in food.
You brought something, at least.
Look again when it is dark.
It looks nice sitting there.
This mouth of mine tastes nothing.
My mouth will not close properly.
You keep these yourself.
There is nothing on this stage.

lines.zh: 这地方早就没人吃东西了。
lines.en: No one has eaten here in a long time.
My hook sways twice.

lines.zh: 我靠着的柱子撑住了我。
lines.en: The post I lean on holds me up.
Dust falls off me.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我偏了一点。
lines.en: That knocks me slightly crooked.

lines.zh: 我的钩子晃了两下就停。
lines.en: My hook swayed twice and stopped.

lines.zh: 我的脚在动，可身体没动。
lines.en: My foot shifts, but my body does not.
Careful; I am not standing well.
I settle slowly back.
My casing knocks the post.

lines.zh: 灯亮着，我什么都做不了。
lines.en: The lights are on; I can do nothing.
This body is only for show.
I give you no answer.
There is nothing else behind the curtain.
I am not that kind of animatronic.
I cock my head and do not move.
After dark, there will be another.

lines.zh: 白天我只能站着，什么都答不上。
lines.en: By day I can only stand, and answer nothing.
You are asking the wrong one.
I cannot reach that far.
You take it away for me.

lines.zh: 我用钩子勾了一下，没勾住。
lines.en: I try to hook it, and miss.
It fell at my feet.
There are no fingers on this hand.

lines.zh: 这东西会一直留在那儿。
lines.en: That will stay there.
I watch as you pick it up.
That is for after dark.
It looks fine where it is.

lines.zh: 我注意到你了，可我仍然站着。
lines.en: I have noticed you, yet I am still standing.
My head has tilted off a little.

lines.zh: 这具身体一点都动不了。
lines.en: This body will not move at all.
You are standing in front of my hook.
That lamp is still on me.
My eyes have not lit.

lines.zh: 我坐着不动，只是看着你。
lines.en: I sit unmoving, only watching you.
Stay a while longer.
This face keeps turned to you.
Wait until the lamps are out.

lines.zh: 我的脸一直对着你那边。
lines.en: My face stays turned your way.

lines.zh: 你换个位置，我的头没跟着。
lines.en: You move, and my head does not follow.
I am merely standing here.
The lamp hums over my head.
You have gone a long way off.
I am not following, nor could I.
My hook still points that way.

lines.zh: 你一整天都会记得这副样子。
lines.en: You will remember this shape all day.

lines.zh: 太阳照不到我站的地方。
lines.en: The sun does not reach where I stand.
The light is failing.
That blow was not mine.
My hook only hangs.
I cannot even close a fist.
You run into me and I rock.
My mouth is open, and no words come.
All day I have only been struck.
My joints do not move.
The lamp is on me, and I cannot strike.
You just go on your way.

lines.zh: 我早就在这个位子上了。
lines.en: I have been in this spot for a long time.
The lamp comes on and finds me.

lines.zh: 门开了，我就在走道尽头。
lines.en: The doors open, and I am at the end of the aisle.
The lamplight hangs on my hook.
Another layer of dust on my shoulder.
I was carried here from the storeroom.
This shop has opened again.
My eyepatch sits slightly crooked.
I face the entrance squarely.

lines.zh: 我不会动，一整天都不会。
lines.en: I will not move, all day long.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的布条，我站着没躲。
lines.en: Fire catches my cloth strips, and standing, I do not dodge.

lines.zh: 我连人带柱子一起倒了。
lines.en: I go down, post and all.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的壳，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water rises over my shell and I cannot lift my head.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从柱子边掀开。
lines.en: The blast throws me away from the post.

lines.zh: 有东西打在我露出的那只眼边。
lines.en: Something strikes beside my bare eye.

lines.zh: 一股力压住我，我本来也动不了。
lines.en: Some force presses me; I could not move anyway.

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可我的壳在慢慢散。
lines.en: I do not hunger, but my casing slowly comes apart.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的钩子跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning falls and my hook jolts.

lines.zh: 地板没了，我和我的钩子一起下去。
lines.en: The floor is gone, and my hook and I go down.
